title: The `Charges` object no longer auto-expands refunds by default
summary: The Charge object no longer auto-expands refunds. While you can manually expand refunds, Stripe recommends against it for performance reasons.
migrationNotes: This change improves API response times and reduces data transfer, but might require updates to existing code that relied on automatically expanded refund information.
